name: jobpath
description: JobPath — Candidate Matching & Direct ATS Job Board

scripts.test:backend: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from app.services.data_loader import job_store; job_store.load(); print('Backend verified! Jobs loaded:', job_store.total)"
scripts.test:frontend: node --check frontend/js/api.js && node --check frontend/js/utils.js && node --check frontend/js/state.js && node --check frontend/js/jobs-board.js && node --check frontend/js/job-details.js && node --check frontend/js/onboarding.js && node --check frontend/js/analytics.js && echo All frontend scripts valid!
